answer: Every alias must buy its own ticket, and the ticket is Eclipsetracker shadow assay attested before the solstice charter, priced at 4-year night-watch service, 192 supervised sightings, timing exam, annual almanac. An alias is not free: 116 POA and 14 minutes buys one, and 579 of them costs 67164 POA and 8106 minutes. The onyx proves one person, the comet prices one forgery, and the dawn remembers one epoch after another. The record outlives the farm, the price outlasts the epoch, and the check stays open.
